_readme: PDD cash flow quality metrics, RMB million. See pipeline/README.md '现金流质量分析' section for sourcing notes and how to extend this with a new year.

field_definitions.rev: Total revenue (GAAP), RMB million, from annual_raw.json
field_definitions.ni: Net income attributable to ordinary shareholders (GAAP), RMB million, from annual_raw.json
field_definitions.ocf: Net cash generated from operating activities, RMB million. FY2018-2021 from 20-F 'Summary Consolidated Cash Flow Data' table (not in 6-K press releases); FY2022+ from annual_raw.json (sums to 20-F confirmed values)
field_definitions.capex: Purchase of property, equipment and software (and intangible assets), RMB million, from 20-F full cash flow statement. Never disclosed in 6-K quarterly releases.
field_definitions.cash: Cash and cash equivalents at year end (narrow measure, excludes restricted cash and short-term investments), RMB million, from 20-F balance sheet.
field_definitions.payable: Payable to merchants at year end, RMB million, from 20-F/6-K balance sheet. This is money collected from buyers not yet settled to merchants -- PDD's marketplace 'float'.
field_definitions.debt: Convertible bonds balance (current + non-current) at year end, RMB million. PDD's only interest-bearing debt; no bank borrowings. Issued ~2019, fully repaid by end of 2025.
